summary: Federal Home Loan Bank of New York filed an 8-K on August 19, 2026, announcing a quarterly dividend declaration of 6.69% (annualized) for Q2 2026, distributed to member institutions on August 20, 2026. This is a routine dividend announcement, not a capital return special situation or other special category. The filing includes the President's Report and a safe harbor statement. No merger, acquisition, tender offer, or strategic event is involved. What to watch: none; this is a standard operational update with no investment implications beyond the ordinary dividend.
